title: Cross-org Rapid Action Register (Jul 2025)
summary: Lightweight register to surface immediate cross-team actions from last week’s oncall/canary incidents and the Q3 pilot model rollout. Designed for quick syncs (5–10m) and handoffs — not a replacement for formal project tickets.
body:
Columns: Action ID | Topic | Area/Owner (team) | Priority | ETA | Status | Blockers | Last updated | Notes

RA-01 | Canary regression: sharp latency spikes on s-8 region | Serving runtime / Raj Patel (eng-serving-runtime) | P0 | 2025-07-11 | In progress | Investigating: suspected kernel mismatch on new AMI (JIRA-4532) | 2025-07-12 | Raj: root cause hypothesis: custom kernel + cudNN drift. Next: reproduce with perf test (oncall @raj). Add rollback window for canary nodes.

RA-02 | Billing anomaly: unusually high embedding cost for beta customers | Finance & Dedicated / Sophie Nguyen (finance) | P1 | 2025-07-14 | Open | Need raw billing export from infra billing bucket (s3://billing/2025/07) | 2025-07-11 | Sophie to request export and run aggregation by model-version. Possible cause: fallback to larger model during quota hit.

RA-03 | Console: per-route latency dashboard missing for private deployments | Product / Liam O'Connor (product-hosted-api) | P1 | 2025-07-18 | In progress | Missing telemetry mapping for private agent (CONFLUENCE-rapid-action-plan) | 2025-07-12 | Quick fix: add synthetic checks to private agent telemetry. Longer term: unify metrics schema.

RA-04 | Security review ask: KMS rotation docs incomplete for on-prem package | Security & Private / Miguel Torres (security-and-compliance) | P2 | 2025-07-25 | Open | Need diagrams from infra (ticket JIRA-4678) | 2025-07-10 | Miguel to draft rotation playbook; include CLI steps and HSM note.

RA-05 | Model rollout: fallback policy not applied when quantized variant missing | Serving runtime / Raj Patel (eng-serving-runtime) | P0 | 2025-07-13 | Blocked | Model registry sync failing on hash mismatch (see github.com/redwood-inference/ops/PR-210) | 2025-07-12 | Hold canary until registry fix. Product to pause scheduled rollouts.

RA-06 | Customer ask: Dedicated capacity burst credits clarification | Customer Success / Priya Malhotra (customer-success) | P2 | 2025-07-20 | Open | Legal needs pricing language approved | 2025-07-09 | Priya to prep one-pager and route to legal@redwood. Action: finalize by Jul 20.

RA-07 | Short-term eval set: perf regressions on 4k sequences | Applied ML / Hana Kim (applied-ml) | P1 | 2025-07-16 | In progress | Need representative prompts from product (linked to CONFLUENCE-rapid-action-plan) | 2025-07-12 | Hana: running microbench with 16-batch, will share CSV.

RA-08 | Telemetry gap: token-level cost attribution missing for new SDK | Observability / Noah Green (observability) | P1 | 2025-07-15 | In progress | SDK PR needs trace/span names standardized (PR 422) | 2025-07-12 | Noah to add middleware shim and update docs.

RA-09 | Quick UX ask: rollout banner copy for users during canary throttles | Design & Product / Maya Lopez (product-hosted-api) | P3 | 2025-07-14 | In review | Waiting on translated strings | 2025-07-11 | Maya to push copy to i18n repo and add fallback English.\nNotes to owners: - Keep rows short, update last updated when you make a change. - Use Action ID (RA-##) for quick refs in Slack. - If an item graduates to >2 week work, create a proper JIRA and link it here.

Open questions / To decide: - Who owns post-mortem for RA-01? (suggest: eng-serving-runtime + sRE). - Can finance get a daily billing dump until root cause identified? Sophie to confirm.

Quick view (for standup): P0: RA-01 (In progress), RA-05 (Blocked). P1: RA-02, RA-03, RA-07, RA-08. P2+: RA-04, RA-06, RA-09.

Slack shorthands: - ping #oncall for oncall bisection updates - use thread: C03A12 for RA-01

TODOs (author): - Add link to perf reproduction script (local path) - Add owner phone for urgent paging - Schedule 10m sync Friday 2025-07-11 at 09:00 PT (invite: emily.chen@redwood.ai)
